LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT ACT 2010

LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT (RATES OF FARES FOR EXPRESS BUS SERVICES)
REGULATIONS 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 75 (1) of the
Land Public Transport Act 2010 [Act 715], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Land Public Transport ( Rates of
Fares for Express Bus Services) Regulations 2026.

 (2) These Regulations come into operation on 15 June 2026.

Rates of fares for express bus services
2. Any person may demand, collect and retain such fares in relation to a public service
vehicle service for any  express bus service  categorized as an economy express bus and
executive express bus under the Land Public Transport (Prescription of Category of
Express Bus Services) Regulations 2022 [ P.U. (A) 206/2022] at the rates as specified
in the Schedule.
